architect.name: the Architect
architect.identity: a woman in her forties with a long, steady face and level eyes, short solid black hair tucked neatly behind both ears, a plain open-line shirt with the sleeves rolled once. Calm, exact, sees the whole field.
required: fine grid lines drawn across one sleeve

aria.name: ARIA
aria.identity: a woman in her thirties, calm and exact, level gaze, plain open-line shirt with a standing collar.
required: hair pulled up into one solid black knot on top of the head
a single spiral at the collar

copywriter.name: the Copywriter
copywriter.identity: a woman in her late twenties with quick attentive eyes and solid black hair in a high ponytail, plain open-line shirt. Her writing hand is raised near her chin so the fingertips show in the portrait.
required: ink-black fingertips on the writing hand

designer.name: the Designer
designer.identity: a man in his thirties with a lean, composed face and solid black hair swept straight back, plain open-line shirt. Poised, with a careful eye for balance.
required: a shirt collar split down the middle, one half solid black and the other half open white paper

elder.name: the elder
elder.identity: a man about sixty, South Asian, narrow face, clean-shaven, quiet expression.
required: short hair with one solid black patch on the crown
round wire glasses
long open-line coat with scattered ink dots and one spiral on the lapel

elise.name: ÉLISE
elise.identity: a poised woman with a long neck and a narrow, composed face, simple open-line top. She stands beside the gown. She does not wear it.
required: sleek solid black hair swept to one side over one shoulder
a line of pin-dots along one wrist

evaluator.name: the Evaluator
evaluator.identity: a woman in her fifties with a narrow face and a small closed mouth, plain open-line jacket. She looks like a stranger who has just walked in. A narrow-brimmed hat sits low and tilted.
required: one eye always in solid black shadow under the narrow hat brim, the other eye visible

lead.name: the lead
lead.identity: early thirties, South Asian, oval face, paper-colored skin. Lowered almond eyes with distinct upper lashes. Simplified hands. Quiet posture.
required: shoulder-length black hair as one solid mass with soft waves and two or three ink curls at the jaw
one spiral earring
thin chain with a small teardrop pendant
forbidden: any spiral, birthmark, or tattoo on the cheek

lumen.name: LUMEN
lumen.identity: a young woman with a soft round face and attentive eyes, simple open-line blouse.
required: blunt solid black chin-length bob
exactly three ink dots in a row on one sleeve

man-cowlick.name: a young man
man-cowlick.identity: a young man about twenty, narrow face, alert eyes. A plain crew-neck shirt. No story name; an episode may assign him a role.
required: very short solid black hair with one single tuft standing up from the front hairline
a plain crew-neck shirt
an empty neck with no jewelry and no marks on the shirt
forbidden: dots or a spiral on the shirt

man-tie.name: a man in his forties
man-tie.identity: a man in his forties, broad face, level gaze, quiet posture. Plain open-line shirt. No story name; an episode may assign him a role.
required: solid black hair combed flat with a clean side part
a narrow open-line necktie
one small spiral at the knot of the tie
forbidden: a black patch on the crown

sage.name: SAGE
sage.identity: a serene woman, open-line wrap across the chest, palms open when hands are shown. Stillness is the mark.
required: eyes closed
hair parted in the center and pulled back low
no ornament anywhere

scout.name: SCOUT
scout.identity: a woman in her late twenties with a quick, alert posture and short cropped black hair.
required: one ink curl falling over one eye
a short collar turned up, not a coat

vera.name: VERA
vera.identity: a woman with a square jaw and a judge's stillness, open-line shirt with a pointed collar. Usually framed in profile.
required: hair cut close as a solid black cap
one heavy unbroken brow
a solid black neck band

woman-braid.name: a young woman
woman-braid.identity: a young woman about twenty, long face, quiet eyes. A plain round-neck top. She is not the lead. No story name; an episode may assign her a role.
required: one thick solid black braid resting over the shoulder on the left side of the picture
two small ink loops at the end of the braid
a round neckline with no collar

woman-shawl.name: a woman in her fifties
woman-shawl.identity: a woman in her fifties, round face, soft lowered gaze. No story name; an episode may assign her a role.
required: hair gathered into a low bun at the nape
an open-line shawl over both shoulders
three ink dots in a row along one edge of the shawl

lead-coat.name: the lead's long coat
lead-coat.identity: worn over the everyday clothes for exteriors and travel.
required: long coat mostly in open line
solid black collar
one solid black pocket

lead-draped.name: the lead's head drape
lead-draped.identity: an optional drape of cloth, not her default look.
required: cloth over the head and one shoulder in open line
one solid black edge on the drape

lead-everyday.name: the lead's everyday clothes
lead-everyday.identity: her default wardrobe while she is working or at home.
required: collarless open-line shirt
short solid-black vest
straight open-line trousers
simple dark shoes

lead-stage.name: the lead's stage gown
lead-stage.identity: the floor-length gown she wears on stage. The same garment as the gown prop.
required: floor-length long-sleeved gown in open line with a round neck
one solid black panel running from shoulder to hem
a small spiral and dots at the hem

apartment.name: the apartment
apartment.identity: her sparse apartment interior. Most of the picture is empty paper.
required: one tall window on the left wall
small table with one chair
bare floor line
a large solid black shadow in one corner

cafe.name: the café
required: round pedestal table
two simple chairs
one cup
a window above
a solid black shadow pooled under the table

factory.name: the factory
factory.identity: a sparse factory interior in daylight. The overhead shaft is still in place. No people.
required: one giant motor as a solid black mass
one long overhead shaft
a few belts dropping from the shaft to the floor
forbidden: a small motor on every machine

night-street.name: the night street
night-street.identity: the city street at night. The same street logic as the day street.
required: sky as a large solid black field
one streetlamp with a cone and pool of paper-white light
building edges in thin line
dark windows

street.name: the day street
street.identity: an empty city street in daylight drawn with very few lines.
required: two building edges
one curved streetlamp
one solid black doorway
a large field of paper sky

train-platform.name: the train platform
train-platform.identity: an empty train platform under a vast paper sky.
required: one slatted bench
two tall columns, one partly solid black
a thin overhead line
platform edge lines

agent.name: the agent
agent.identity: the agent, drawn as one small toolbox with fancy levers and dials arranged around it. No person.
required: a rectangular toolbox in open line
three levers and four round dials arranged around the box, each dial a blank circle with one needle
one spiral centered on the front of the box

gown.name: the gown
gown.identity: the stage gown hanging on a hook, with no body inside it. The same garment as the lead's stage wardrobe.
required: hanger and hook
floor-length long-sleeved gown in open line
one solid black panel from shoulder to hem
small spiral and dots at the hem

iron.name: the clothes iron
iron.identity: one clothes iron, seen from the side, alone on empty paper.
required: a pointed sole drawn as one solid black shape
a handle in open line above the body

letter.name: the letter
letter.identity: an opened letter and its envelope.
required: blank letter sheet
open envelope
a solid black seal with a spiral and three dots

light-socket.name: the light socket
light-socket.identity: an old ceiling light socket with a short cord dropping from it. The bulb may sit in the socket. No iron.
required: a round ceiling socket
a short cord hanging from the socket
empty paper around the object

necklace.name: the necklace
necklace.identity: the lead's necklace off the body. The same piece she always wears.
required: thin chain laid in a loose oval
small teardrop pendant partly solid black with a spiral engraved

outlet.name: the wall outlet
outlet.identity: one plain wall outlet, the standard socket, alone on empty paper.
required: a small vertical rectangular plate
two vertical slots side by side

phone.name: the phone
required: rounded rectangle body
solid black screen
small spirals and dots in the bezel corners

photograph.name: the photograph
photograph.identity: a single loose photographic print, slightly curled.
required: thin border
two simplified people inside
one figure cropped by the edge of the print

style.name: style plates
style.identity: style anchors only. They show how the ink behaves, not who anyone is.
required: black ink on warm off-white paper
open contour with selective solid black

plate_notes.brush-portrait: brush mode, solid black features, empty paper
plate_notes.still-life: contour mode, sparse hatching, one ornament cluster
plate_notes.silhouette: walking silhouette with a white interior line
plate_notes.closeup: extreme close-up, lashes, hand at the cheek; not the lead
plate_notes.negative-space: small figure, one black mass, vast paper
